clue.text: Jewish student in taxi in front of the top people

indicators.note: puts the taxi word ahead of the top people in the answer

parts.note: a taxi is a cab
the A-list is the set of top celebrities

explanation.surface: A Jewish student rides in a cab ahead of the elite.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabalist studies the Kabbalah, the Jewish mystical tradition, so is a student of Jewish lore.

clue.text: Vessel has sign of damage — a different receptacle's to be brought in

indicators.note: says the other pieces are put inside the sign of damage

parts.note: a chip is a small mark showing something has been damaged
taken as written
a bin is another kind of receptacle from the vessel; the 's supplies a plural S

explanation.surface: A damaged ship is to take aboard some other container.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' looks like the receptacle in the surface, but it is the definition; the 's of 'receptacle's' makes the bin plural.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabin ship is a passenger liner carrying a single class of cabin passengers, so a kind of vessel.

clue.text: Something absorbing for a man of letters?

definitions.text: Something absorbing for a man of letters?

parts.words: Something absorbing for a man of letters?
parts.note: pad of soaking paper used to dry ink on letters just written; 'absorbing' pretends to mean engrossing

explanation.surface: Seems to ask what would engross a literary man.
explanation.definitionFit: Blotting paper soaks up wet ink, so it literally absorbs something for anyone writing letters.

clue.text: It's bound to get left on roof of a hut

indicators.note: in a down entry, places the left letter above the rest

parts.note: a shed is a hut

explanation.surface: Something tied down has to be attached on top of a hut.
explanation.definitionFit: Lashed and bound both mean tied tightly with rope or cord.

clue.text: Carol's hiding below, breaking up

indicators.note: the singing word has the other word concealed inside it

parts.note: to carol is to sing; the 's is 'has'
under means below

explanation.surface: Carol is hiding underneath while things fall apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carol' looks like a woman's name but is the verb to sing.
explanation.definitionFit: To sunder is to split apart, so sundering is breaking up.

clue.text: Country's leader discarded by revolutionary soldiers

parts.note: cast means thrown away or discarded

indicators.note: something revolving turns round, so the soldiers' letters are read backwards

parts.note: OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A national leader is dumped by rebel troops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' suits Cuba's revolution in the surface, but its job is to turn the soldiers round.
explanation.definitionFit: Fidel Castro was the long-time head of Cuba, so a country's leader.

clue.text: Hymn tune hourly in church

indicators.note: puts the hourly word inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
horal is an old word meaning relating to hours

explanation.surface: A hymn is played every hour in church.
explanation.definitionFit: A chorale is a stately Lutheran hymn melody, so a hymn tune.

clue.text: Most insignificant group sent up in insult

indicators.note: puts the group word inside the insult word

parts.note: a slight is an insult

indicators.note: in a down clue, sending up means reading the word bottom to top

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.surface: A mocked group might feel slighted by a petty jibe.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'sent up' means read upwards; the turned group sits just before the insult's final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Slightest is the superlative of slight, meaning smallest or least important.

clue.text: Let out and let out again?

definitions.meaning: to rent out a property a second time

explanation.surface: Seems to ask about freeing something twice over.
explanation.definitionFit: Release means set free, and re-lease means lease or let a property once more.

clue.text: Short work of literature? I don't like it!

indicators.note: cut short, so the literary work loses its last letter

parts.note: a book is a work of literature

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses a slim book with a jeer.
explanation.definitionFit: Boo is the exclamation of disapproval shouted at something disliked.

clue.text: Member of governing body's spurious rationales

indicators.note: false or not genuine, so the letters of the word rationales are rearranged

explanation.surface: A legislator offers bogus justifications.
explanation.definitionFit: Senatorial means belonging to a senator, a member of a governing senate.

clue.text: Attender unfortunately rattled on in talk

indicators.note: suggests things gone wrong, so the letters of attender are jumbled

explanation.surface: A meeting-goer sadly chattered away.
explanation.definitionFit: To natter is to chatter at length, so to have rattled on in conversation.

clue.text: A quiet sheep in retreat

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A silent sheep hides away in a refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: An ashram is a Hindu religious hermitage, a place of spiritual retreat.

clue.text: Sin by husband, a German mister

parts.note: to err is to sin

explanation.surface: A husband commits a sin.
explanation.definitionFit: Herr is the German title used where English says Mr.

clue.text: Testimonial provided as priority, but first page is lost

indicators.note: says that letter is removed from the priority word

parts.note: preference means priority, as in giving preference

indicators.note: takes the opening letter of the word page

explanation.surface: A recommendation got priority but its opening page went missing.
explanation.definitionFit: A reference is a written testimonial about someone's character or work.

clue.text: Daughter is stern, daughter torn apart?

parts.note: D again for daughter
severe means stern
D again for daughter

explanation.surface: A strict daughter leaves another daughter emotionally torn.
explanation.definitionFit: Dissevered means cut or split into parts, separated.

clue.text: Spot affairs in job

definitions.meaning: a state of affairs, how things stand
a post or position of employment

explanation.surface: Someone notices goings-on at work.
explanation.definitionFit: Situation can mean a location, the current state of affairs, or a job, as in situations vacant.

clue.text: Fury in party with American threatening

indicators.note: puts the fury word inside the party word

parts.note: a do is a party
anger is fury

explanation.surface: Rage at a party with an American is menacing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dangerous poses a threat, so threatening is a close synonym.

clue.text: Debauched academic to get tied up

parts.note: a prof is a professor, an academic
ligate is a verb meaning to tie up, as surgeons do a blood vessel

explanation.surface: A dissolute don ends up bound.
explanation.definitionFit: A profligate person is recklessly dissolute, so debauched in conduct.

clue.text: One may take river walk, right?

definitions.text: One may take river walk, right?

parts.note: to amble is to walk at a leisurely pace

explanation.surface: Asks whether someone might go for a riverside stroll.
explanation.definitionFit: A rambler is a hiker who walks for pleasure, perhaps along a river.

clue.text: This person's a chum in Muslim territory

parts.note: 'this person is' from the speaker's point of view is I am, shortened to I'm
a mate is a chum

explanation.surface: Someone says they are a friend in Muslim lands.
explanation.definitionFit: An imamate is the region ruled by an imam, a Muslim territory.

clue.text: Lake given name by sailor

parts.note: a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor names a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarn is a small mountain lake, as in the English Lake District.

clue.text: Like some languages that would be tricky for a rustic

indicators.note: something tricky is twisted, so the letters of a rustic are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some tongues would trip up a country bumpkin.
explanation.definitionFit: Austric is a proposed language family of Southeast Asia and the Pacific, so describes some languages.

clue.text: Test gold before transaction

indicators.note: puts the gold word ahead of the transaction

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
a deal is a transaction

explanation.surface: Gold is assayed before a sale.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a harsh trial, a severe test of endurance.

clue.text: Rampaging army's capturing any number in ancient city

indicators.note: the jumbled letters take the number inside them
running wild, so the letters of army's are scrambled

parts.note: N stands for any number in maths

explanation.surface: A rampaging army takes captives in an old city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rampaging' turns ARMYS into SMYRA, and 'capturing' puts N inside it before the A.
explanation.definitionFit: Smyrna was an ancient Greek city on the Aegean coast, now Izmir in Turkey.

clue.text: A girl ensnared by backward little devil in Scottish location

indicators.note: the reversed word traps the other pieces inside
means the little devil's word is read in reverse

parts.note: an elf is a mischievous little sprite
Iris is a girl's name

explanation.walkthrough: 'backward' gives FLE; 'ensnared by' puts the other pieces inside it. Fair Isle is one of the Shetland islands.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair Isle is a remote island in the Shetlands, so a place in Scotland.

clue.text: County road in which money is hidden by Irish

parts.note: a lane is a small road

indicators.note: places the money next to the Irish abbreviation

parts.note: cash is money

explanation.surface: A rural road where Irish folk have stashed money.
explanation.walkthrough: The road's final E comes after the hidden pieces. Lancashire is a county in north-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Lancashire is an English county in the north-west, home to Manchester and Liverpool historically.

clue.text: Disturbance curtailed in foreign port

parts.note: a riot is a disturbance

explanation.definitionFit: Rio de Janeiro is a major Brazilian seaport, foreign to British solvers.

clue.text: Cheeses said to give wind

indicators.note: signals that the word is spoken, so what is heard matters

parts.note: bries are soft French cheeses

explanation.surface: A jibe that certain cheeses cause flatulence.

clue.text: Crook can steal literary work
